title: PowerPoint on Mac: reference a Teams meeting or chat when creating a presentation with Copilot Agent Mode
summary: Hold: the briefing says Microsoft has not stated whose permissions govern access, but Microsoft's Copilot privacy guidance explicitly limits organizational data to what the individual user can access. The assertion that the generated deck has its own sharing also needs evidence or narrower wording. The roadmap facts and both control paths and commands are supported.

claims.claim: No Microsoft Learn page specific to this feature beyond the release-note entry was found.
claims.quote: Searched: "PowerPoint" "Teams meeting or chat"; PowerPoint Agent Mode reference Teams meeting chat licence permissions transcript default admin policy. Opened release-notes and product requirements; no separate feature-specific Learn page found.

claims.where: Governance guidance: At rollout; Open questions; changes[0]
claims.claim: Microsoft has not said whose permissions govern which Teams meetings and chats a user can reference.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot only surfaces organizational data to which individual users have at least view permissions.
claims.fix: Replace the broad permission-unknown statements with: 'Microsoft states that Copilot only surfaces organizational data to which the individual user has at least view permissions.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/plan/microsoft-365-copilot-privacy. In the rollout test, replace 'since Microsoft has not said whose permissions apply' with 'to validate the documented user-permission boundary'. Remove the permissions question from Open questions and 'permission model not yet published' from changes[0]. The narrower observation that this release-note entry omits permission details can remain.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: The feature produces a new presentation from the referenced content.
claims.quote: Users can enter a prompt that mentions the relevant Teams meeting or chat, and Copilot will generate a deck based on that content.

claims.where: Why it matters: first paragraph
claims.claim: The resulting deck has its own sharing, separate from the source meeting or chat.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot generated PowerPoint presentation new file sharing permissions separate source content; Copilot generated documents sharing permissions source files new content inherits permissions. Read release-notes, privacy guidance and data-protection search excerpts; no stating passage found.
claims.fix: Remove 'because the deck is a new file with its own sharing' from Why it matters. Keep the recommendation to review how generated decks are shared as the wiki's advice, without asserting an undocumented permission-transfer mechanism.
